svg.title: Furusato: make data mean more
svg.desc: Illustrated cover for an independent workshop using Microsoft Fabric. Original Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, Eventhouse, Ontology and Data Agent icons identify their corresponding products and items. Their artwork is unchanged and proportionally scaled. The orbital artwork is decorative, not a screenshot or execution result.

g.text: From data engineering to grounded AI answers.
Build it. Ask it. Trace the evidence.
A WORKSHOP YOU CAN BUILD, QUERY & VERIFY
